summary: The r40 proposed universal weak-L2 bound for U_g(s)=sup_eta |int g(h)e^{-i(sh^2+eta h)}dh| is false even for probability densities 0<=g<=1. For every N an explicit fragmented cap-one density g_N has sup_lambda lambda^2 meas{U_gN>lambda} >= c N. This refutes only the worst-modulation maximal-envelope glue, not target-wide Fourier-L1 or QFORM. Future chirp work must retain the actual modulation average/distribution or use a physical compound-volume/direct-density receiver.
